ROOT CAUSE A (systemic): reattachAfterReload() calls page.evaluate(fn, undefined, {timeout:240000}) — Playwright takes only (fn, arg) and throws "Too many arguments". So the reattach throws at EVERY group boundary (desktop/pad/touch/viewport/rebind), window.__IC page helpers are never reinstalled after a reload, and the run records PAGE/after-<group> unmeasurable whose threshold text claims "every later group in this run is unmeasurable" while 40 later checks report pass. A false unmeasurable — the mirror of the round-1 false pass — in the very file built to stop them.

CONSEQUENCE OF A: the M-K20 / M-K20-empty / M-P24 self-test legs die with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading instructionBudget)" — they read window.__IC. M-K18 (rebind completable on all three modalities) and M-P23 (pad-only rebind) FAIL with began:false, also candidates for the missing helpers.
SEPARATE LEG DEFECTS (no error, simply did not go red): M-P5 (roll/sprint discriminator to 1 frame), M-P14 (freeze prompt glyph), M-K22 (make the prompt say Press E), M-K9 (swallow Escape).

SUCCESSOR-3 ROOT CAUSE B — the M-K18/M-P23 FAILs are FALSE, and the build is fine. Bisected: --group rebind alone = 4/4 pass; --group viewport,rebind = M-K18+M-P23 FAIL with steps [idle,idle,idle]. TWO leftovers from the viewport group, neither in the build: (1) mp20 ends on openMenu(book) and a screen takes interact every frame (S14), and it ALSO enters the CENSUS, which holds the keyboard because it has a typed field — that is why the keyboard leg died beside a live pad and touch leg and looked like a defect in the keyboard path; reset() does NOT stand an entered census down, censusBegin({}) does (it re-arms paused). (2) the viewport group leaves pointer:coarse, so GamepadRouter selects souls-handheld (gamepad.js:134) where index 0 is jump, not interact — the check was pressing A and calling the surface uncompletable.

SUCCESSOR-3 FIXES: mp20 now stands down its own census and screen; the rebind check ASSERTS and RECORDS its preconditions (ui mode, device class, pad profile, census) instead of inheriting them; the pad leg drives whatever control the ACTIVE profile gives interact, honouring the handheld tap/hold gate, and now runs on BOTH shipped profiles (a stricter check than before); an unclearable census makes M-K18/M-P23 unmeasurable, not FAIL. Result after viewport: 10/11 pass, both rebind checks OK, preconditions recorded {world, desktop, souls-default, census false}.

SUCCESSOR-3 DELETE-THE-FIX on the reattach: re-introducing the 3-arg page.evaluate brings the false PAGE/after-* unmeasurable entries straight back (desktop+rebind: 24/27 with 3 unmeasurable vs 25/25 clean).

SUCCESSOR-3 REAL BUILD DEFECT FOUND BY THE REPAIRED INSTRUMENT: a calibration learned on an unrecognised pad was applied to EVERY pad afterwards. gamepad.js _adoptPad drops the old pads profile and quirk map on an id change (its comment says so) but calibrationResult is instance state and was never cleared. MEASURED: calibrate Some Unknown Pad 9000 (6 inputs), unplug, plug in a standard GameSir -> index 0 fired ROLL and index 5 fired LOCK_ON. With the one-line fix (perm applies only when calibrationResult.id === st.id): index 0 interact, index 5 light, and L5 still holds — the stranger returning keeps its own map (raw 0 light). DELETE-THE-FIX reproduces roll/lock_on exactly.

SUCCESSOR-3: M-K18/M-P23 were FALSE FAILS three times over — an open book screen, an entered census holding the keyboard, the handheld pad profile, a one-frame read window, and finally the calibration leak.
